title: "V0002 unterminated"
description: "A string literal, interpolation or block comment reaches the end of the file without being closed."
---

An error from the `lex` phase. `sakura explain V0002` prints this explanation offline.

A string literal, interpolation or block comment reaches the end of the file without being
closed.

Wrong:

```sakura
let s = "hello
```

Fixed:

```sakura
let s = "hello"
```
